init.description: Run the preset-driven init pipeline (FSD Lite, agent rules, GitHub templates, review) against a clean working tree

add-integration.description: Preview the official installation flow for a supported external integration

add-review.description: Install the Claude PR review workflow

add-backend.description: Wire a backend app into the workspace: shared-types lib, scope tags, and module-boundary constraints

add-github-templates.description: Install GitHub Issue/PR templates and CODEOWNERS

add-fsd-lite.description: Wire the archweave/fsd-boundaries ESLint rule into the frontend app and print the FSD layer guide

page.description: Scaffold a new FSD page slice under src/pages (src/_pages on Next.js)

widget.description: Scaffold a new FSD widget slice under src/widgets (opt-in: outside the Lite default scope)

feature.description: Scaffold a new FSD feature slice under src/features

entity.description: Scaffold a new FSD entity slice under src/entities

shared.description: Scaffold a new FSD shared slice under src/shared

install-integration.description: Install a supported external integration through its official CLI (on --dryRun=false), verify it live, record it, and declare it

record-integration.description: Verify a manually installed integration and record its verified state

allow-builds.description: Allow dependency build scripts pnpm skipped (pnpm-workspace.yaml) and, on --apply, run pnpm rebuild for them
